$comment: The source of sf-dropdown's element plumbing (core/js/element-manifest.js). Taken from simai/ui-control control/smart-architecture/migration/out/dropdown (migration/convert-1.3.8.mjs over simai/ui-source@5100227); standard simai.smart-component 1.3.8, vocabulary 1.1.5. Every x-todo of the conversion is decided: x-decisions says how.

appearance.summary: How the dropdown looks: a filled field or an outlined one.

columns.summary: How many options a row holds in the grid layout. Ignored in a list.

error-message.summary: The text shown under the field while it is invalid, in the error colour, in the field-message style; it is the trigger's error message for assistive technology (aria-describedby, aria-errormessage).

invalid.summary: Marks the choice as wrong: the error border (filled: the error fill), aria-invalid on the trigger and error-message under the field. No error icon is drawn.

layout.summary: How the options are laid out. A list is one option a row; a grid puts several in a row, which is the only way a hundred glyphs can be looked at -- a column of them is a column nobody scrolls to the end of. In a grid an option shows its picture and keeps its text as the name a search reads and a pointer sees.

multiple.summary: Allow several values while preserving their serialized selection order. Tag mode is multiple by default.

name.summary: Native form field name for the selected machine value.

options.x-shape: ui-source 5100227 src/smart/dropdown/smart.manifest.json inputs.options; a string or a number is both the text and the value; constant options in a manifest give only the value, the text lives in lang roles.<role>.items.<value> (standard 1.3.8 §11.3)
options.summary: Options given as data instead of as sf-list-item children: [{text, value, type?, size?, icon?, selected?, disabled?, colorClass?, avatarImageUrl?, avatarTitle?, ariaLabel?, group?}]. A string or a number is taken as both the label and the value. A parent that renders this dropdown from a template passes its options this way, because capturing child elements means removing them, and the parent can then no longer put a changed list back. Options carrying the same `group`, one after another, are drawn under one heading, so a long list says where each stretch of it comes from instead of repeating that in every row.

placeholder.summary: What the field reads while nothing is chosen. Empty: the text of the page's language ("Not selected" in English, «Не выбрано» in Russian). Nothing is chosen for the person: the value stays empty until they pick.

portal.summary: Anchor the popup with the shared Framework positioning (SF.Position): native top layer, flip, shift and viewport-limited height. On by default; portal="false" keeps the in-flow list.

search-placeholder.summary: Empty: the text of the page's language ("Search" in English).

value.summary: Selected machine value, or a comma-separated list of values for multiple selection.

change.summary: The selection changed; dispatched on the host. The name to bind.

field-reset.summary: The person pressed the reset back to the inherited value. The event of the trait field-inherit@1: one name for every field of the family, so a form hears them all at once and tells them apart by detail.tag. Fired before the field is emptied and cancellable: preventDefault keeps the value. When it is not prevented the field empties, says so with its ordinary change, shows the inherited value again and takes focus back.

tag.summary: The element that was reset, as a tag name.

value.summary: The field's own value before the reset.

inherited-value.summary: The inherited value it returns to.

name.summary: The form name, empty when the field has none.

open-dropdown.summary: Opens the option list unless the control is disabled or already open. Returns the element.

close-dropdown.summary: Closes the option list and clears the search text. Returns the element.

toggle-dropdown.summary: Closes the list when open, opens it otherwise. Returns the element.

set-error.summary: Show an error message and the invalid state, or clear both with an empty message. Writes error-message and invalid and sets the custom error the form will not submit over. Returns the element.

relations.name: cl-icon
$comment: The picture of a single choice in the field and an icon tag's icon are sf-icon elements,
so their names reach the first icon font request (2026-11-09, as sf-tag 1.3.2).

default.$comment: The Lit template in JavaScript, the migration form of §5.2 (§16).

aliases.$comment: Dated aliases of sf-dropdown for the shim (core/js/aliases.js, standard §16 item 20). mode: same-detail (setting rows), split (the old detail from the element's adapter), host-attribute (no shim).

rows.summary: Legacy name for appearance, still honoured. See contracts/public-api-axes.json.

rows.note: stays a host attribute, read for the accessible name; no shim
the old detail adds root (the element), which §8 takes out of the new detail: the element's detail adapter makes it
rows.summary: Legacy name for change, still emitted with the same detail; bind change.

rows.note: the event of the trait field-inherit@1, declared in component.json as the shared event field-reset; the field sends sf-field-reset and the shim follows it with this dated name, same detail, one cancel
rows.summary: The person pressed the reset back to the inherited value. Fired before the field is emptied and cancellable: preventDefault keeps the value. When it is not prevented the field empties, says so with its ordinary change, shows the inherited value again and takes focus back.

x-summary: Accessible single or multiple selection control with searchable options and optional portal projection.
x-renamed: settings.aria-label: a host attribute, read by the base, never a setting (§3.1)
settings.columns: type string with the numeral default "6" → number (§16 item 29)
settings.type → appearance: the axis's old name (contracts/public-api-axes.json), alias dated
events.sf-dropdown:change → change: vocabulary §5.1 (a value changed), the colon name a dated alias
x-decisions: trait-words: the shared field words (inherited, reset, described) stay with the trait field-inherit@1, as sf-switch keeps them (x-trait-words in the language files); where a trait's words live is Annex A item 13.
version: 1.3.0 → 1.4.0: type and sf-dropdown:change are dated aliases; change carries no element (root leaves its detail, §8).

a11y-role: combobox, one role: the trigger is a read-only box that opens a listbox (the list's own role); the name is the drawn label, then what the page said of the host (aria-label, aria-labelledby, a label[for]).
existing-aliases: compatibility.migrations lists the move to appearance; type folds into aliases.json as a dated setting row, sf-dropdown:change as a split event row whose old detail keeps root.

form: the host is the form control through ElementInternals (FormField, helpers/form-field.js; §17.1, §17.2) since 1.9.0: it submits the value, reports value-missing while required and empty, and a custom error set with set-error or setCustomValidity(); the hidden input stays drawn for the reset binding and for pages that read it, without a name while the host submits (§17.1 item 6). Before 1.9.0 the contract was kept as x-form and the hidden input submitted (§16 item 11).
template: templates.default names the Lit template js/templates/default.js, the migration form §5.2 allows.

examples: examples.json from studio.fixture.json and studio.scenario.json plus multiple, tags, a grid, search and an inherited value; probe.json drives the arrows, Home, End, Enter, Space, Escape and Tab (gate 16).

css-variables: five public variables read by the sheet with the role tokens as fallbacks (§6): the field's resting background and border, its radius, the gap, and the open list's background. They are not in src/core/contracts/public-variables.v1.json yet: that file and its test are shared with the field family's branches.
side-effects: portal -- the open list is shown in the browser's top layer, or, without it, moved to the end of body (or of the open modal dialog).
layer: kind surface; the open list registers through core open-surface-mark, so Escape reaches it while it is the top layer; it does not trap focus.

change: the change the person made is sent as `change` on the host (a CustomEvent with {value, label, values, item, multiple}); the old name sf-dropdown:change follows with root added, once per change.

version 1.4.1: the first-paint snapshots are retaken: the JSON island is printed once (no held copy), the icon font's state (sf-icon loaded, sf-icon-loaded) is left out, a closed surface prints closed and a size or place the code measured (a non-zero px width, height, inset, clip or transform) is left out, so a snapshot is the same on every run.
version 1.4.2: the first-paint sheet list names the utility sheets its templates draw with (core.runtime 1.0.7 asks for them before the element draws: the style gate).

version 1.4.3: the bundle carries no element layer of its own -- element-manifest, aliases, the alias table, the host port, deprecations, page actions, the layer stack, the open-surface mark and the instance path come from the page's shared runtime (SF.runtimeModule, runtime ABI 1, core.runtime 1.1.0), one instance per page -- and embeds of this file only the keys the runtime reads. Behaviour unchanged.

version 1.4.5: the trait field-inherit@1 event sf-field-reset is dispatched, with sf-field:reset as its dated same-detail alias (aliases.json), as sf-input, sf-textarea and sf-quantity have it. The dropdown declared sf-field:reset but lacked the alias row, so the new name was never sent; the trait code still sends the old name and the shim now sends sf-field-reset first.

version 1.4.6: options given as the options attribute (JSON) are read as data, as the property is, so the chosen option's text shows in the field; the attribute is observed, so a changed one redraws the list (ui-effects site, 2026-10-28).

version 1.5.0: the trait event is declared in component.json as the shared event field-reset (standard 1.3.13 §8: an event a trait brings is named sf-<verb>, with no tag): the element sends sf-field-reset itself and the manifest describes it, with tag in the detail. Before, the registry described only the retired sf-field:reset and no current name, and the new name came from the alias shim alone. The dated sf-field:reset follows with the same detail and one cancel until 2026-12-01.

version 1.6.0: a field with nothing chosen says so. placeholder defaults to the language file's word (runtime.empty: «Не выбрано», «Not selected») instead of nothing, so an unset choice reads as unset; before, the box was blank and a host that could not tell unset from not yet drawn drew the first option (Larena, 2026-11-06: heading align, section background). No option is chosen for the person, the form value stays empty until they pick, and the keyboard opens the list on the search or the first option without choosing it. An inherited value still takes the placeholder's place.

version 1.7.0 (2026-11-07): a minor (a look and the list's markup; settings, values, events and keys unchanged; owner C05-C07, docs review R029, which replaces R017's 1/3 inset; component.dropdown 1.2.0). The open list is a dropping panel with the context menu's geometry, from the shared partial component/context-menu/scss/_panel.scss: an option's highlight stands --sf-space-1/4 from the panel's edge, is as tall as a control of its size and rounded --sf-radius--ui, and its picture or text stands --sf-space-1/2 inside it, the picture --sf-space-1/2 before the text (before, an option lined up with its field). The list says its size (sf-list--size-1/2, -1, -2) and draws no padding: its scroll area holds the inset on every side and is the only part that scrolls. The search is the panel's header, not a boxed sf-input: label.sf-list-search with i.sf-list-search-icon before input.sf-list-search-input -- no frame, no fill, a row's height and the inset above and below, its icon and text over the rows' icon and text, a hairline across the panel under it that turns primary while it has the focus. The scrollbar shows only when the rows do not fit; while it takes room in the layout the scroll area is marked sf-list-container-wrap--scrollbar (component/panel-scrollbar.js, offsetWidth - clientWidth through a ResizeObserver; the portal marks a portalled list, the element a list in place) and gives up its inline-end padding, the track the inset, a thumb of --sf-space-1/4 and the inset again (::-webkit-scrollbar; Firefox thin). Probe dropdown-panels-inset.

version 1.7.1: the inherited state comes with the family's hidden note (helpers/inherited-value.js, syncInheritedNote): when something else describes the control through aria-describedby, the inherited sentence is named there too, because a browser reads aria-describedby instead of aria-description. Its button is described by its summary (the shown option, component/dropdown/interaction.js), so the inherited sentence used to go unsaid; it now follows the summary.

version 1.7.4 (2026-11-09): a patch; nothing in the component changed. A shared sheet it draws with moved in the next block (src/smart/helpers/inherited-value.css, the C27 inherited-value reset), so the component takes a patch with it.

version 1.7.3 (2026-11-08; one number above the two unreleased 1.7.2 it joins): a patch (C06, DEV measurement of the docs on ui-0c23f6a0af12; component.dropdown 1.2.1). When no option has a picture (icon, avatar, colour or checkbox), the search header's text stands over the rows' text and its icon at the header's end; the text stood a search icon and a gap (24-32px) right of the rows'. With pictures nothing changes: icon over icon, text over text. Settings, values, events and keys are unchanged. Its shared helper src/smart/helpers/inherited-value.js changed with the actions block (module.smart-helpers 1.3.0).

version 1.8.0 (2026-11-09): a minor (owner decision C32, the popup widths; component.dropdown 1.5.0, core.runtime position). The list at a field is at least the field and as wide as its longest option up to the list's step or the field, whichever is wider: --sf-popup-list-max-width, 20rem, 18rem in compact density. It was exactly the field, so a short field cut every longer option. Anchored, the positioning gives the field's width as the list's minimum (SF.Position matchWidth "min"); in place (portal="false") the field's box does. A list under a trigger of its own and a grid keep their widths. Settings, events and keys unchanged. In place (portal="false") the list takes its options' width between the same limits and, near the screen's inline end, hangs from the field's end (data-sf-align="end", measured on opening; DEV acceptance, 2026-11-09). The pictures of a choice draw on time: the single choice's icon in the field and an icon tag's icon (mode="tag") printed a bare <i class="sf-icon"> after the page's icon scan, so their names missed the first icon_names request and the glyph came late; both are sf-icon elements now (root-class sf-dropdown-field-visual / sf-tag-icon), cl-icon is a relation, and the field's picture rules reach the glyph inside the sf-icon (tests/browser/dropdown-icon-glyph.browser.mjs).

version 1.8.1 (2026-11-10): a patch (component.dropdown 1.5.1, sf-list-item 1.2.7). The field's chevron and the list's search glyph are sf-icon elements, as the pictures of a choice became in 1.8.0, and so are the icons of icon options (sf-list-item draws them): a bare <i class="sf-icon"> printed after the page's icon scan missed the first icon_names request and its glyph came a round later. The sheets' rules that size and colour those glyphs reach the glyph inside the sf-icon (display: contents) and the sf-icon before it is defined, so the geometry is unchanged; colours stay on-surface-variant at rest and on-disable when disabled. Settings, events and keys are unchanged.

version 1.9.0 (2026-11-11): a minor (owner decision C55, prototype dropdown-error.html variant A; component.dropdown 1.6.0). sf-dropdown is a form field as sf-input is: FormField gives validity, required, form reset and restore; invalid and error-message are settings and set-error {message} the action (as sf-input-quantity's; sf-input itself has none yet); the error look is sf-input's -- the error outline, on filled the error fill, no error icon -- and the message is under the field in sf-input's field-message type with the field's 4 px gap; the trigger carries aria-invalid and aria-describedby/aria-errormessage to the message. A required field left empty shows «Выберите вариант» (lang runtime value-missing) once the form's check fails (the host's invalid event, on a submit attempt or checkValidity/reportValidity), and the browser focuses its trigger; a person's choice that leaves a value clears the shown error, the page's set-error included. The focus ring shows on the field also when focus arrives from code after a pointer press elsewhere (the submit button): before, only keyboard focus (:focus-visible) drew it.

version 1.9.1 (2026-11-12; written on the branch as 1.8.2): a patch (owner decision C106, the scroll-area inset rule, an addendum to C105; component.dropdown 1.6.1). The shared dropping-panel partial component/context-menu/scss/_panel.scss now takes the page scrollbar's thumb, --sf-scroll-thumb-width, as its default: the track is the inset --sf-space-1/4, the thumb and the inset again, 14 (the page's --sf-scroll-bg-width; it was 12, a thumb of --sf-space-1/4). The thumb keeps a transparent border of the inset and background-clip: padding-box; a scrollbar that takes room still marks its area (component/panel-scrollbar.js) and the area gives up its inline-end padding; no scrollbar-gutter. Settings, values, events and keys unchanged; probe dropdown-panels-inset, evidence ui-control control/evidence/2026-11-12-scrollbar-14.

version 1.9.2 (2026-11-13; written on the branch fix/dropdown-wheel-r171 as 1.8.3): a patch (owner remark R171; component.dropdown 1.7.1, core.runtime 1.55.0 SF.Position). The wheel scrolls the list of a portalled dropdown again: the list's own scroll reached the dropdown's page-scroll listener (document, capture) and placed the panel anew, and placing took the height cap off for a moment to measure, so the rows' scroll area stopped overflowing and the browser threw it back to the start -- on every wheel step the list jumped back and stood still. The list's own scroll no longer places the panel, and SF.Position puts back what was scrolled inside a surface after it measures (a page scroll with the list scrolled keeps its place too). Settings, values, events and keys unchanged; evidence ui-control control/evidence/2026-11-12-dropdown-wheel-r171. Same patch, the R171 leftovers (evidence control/evidence/2026-11-12-dropdown-inplace-height): a list in place (portal="false") has the anchored list's height -- the larger room the screen gives above or below the field less the panel's edge padding, measured on opening (component/dropdown/portal.js fitDropdownInPlace, --sf-dropdown-available-block-size; unmeasured, the screen less that padding) -- and only its rows scroll, with the shared panel's 14 track; before, sixty options stood 2.4k px tall and the wheel scrolled the page. SF.Position puts a scroll back at once instead of through the sheet's smooth scrolling, which glided the list from 0 after a page scroll and left it short (784 of 800) when read mid-glide. Same patch, the keyboard reveal (written on the branch fix/dropdown-keyboard-reveal as 1.8.2): The keyboard brings the focused option into view: SF.Position kept a list scrolled to the option no longer than one update (its full fit measured the panel uncapped and the browser threw the rows back to the top), the list's own scroll no longer re-fits the panel, and the reveal is instant and nearest. PageDown and PageUp move by what the rows show; typed letters move to the option they begin (type-ahead). SF.Position puts the scroll back for both remarks through one helper, and the list's own scroll is told apart through its composed path. Same patch, the grid cells (owner remark R211; owner decision 2026-10-14, a grid cell is as tall as a field of the dropdown's size): a grid under a field had columns stretched to the list (four columns under a 32rem field were cells of 125 px, two rows in the 16rem grid instead of six); the columns are now one cell wide on every path (1/2 32, 1 40, 2 48), the grid stands at the inline start, and the list stays as wide as the field (C32).

version 1.10.0 (2026-11-13, owner decision C123 (3); R214 FA-4, FA-5, FA-11): a minor, a look. The chevron is the field's indicator, the field layer's action (component.inputs 1.6.0, .sf-field-action; component.dropdown 1.8.0) in place of a link sf-icon-button with a plate: no plate in any state, the field's leading-picture size (24 / 20 / 28 at 1, 1/2, 2; it was 20 / 20 / 28), on-surface-variant at rest and on-surface while the field is under the pointer or pressed -- the whole field opens the list, as it did. It stays the button that holds the combobox's focus, names and aria-expanded (interaction.js), the field's single Tab stop, and draws no ring of its own: the field's ring is its focus. Its glyph ends on the field's inset, where an option's check ends; the value keeps half an inset before it. A disabled filled field of text still shows none. Settings, values, events and keys unchanged.

version 1.10.1 (written on fix/content-precheck as 1.8.2; 2026-11-10, docs precheck TG-02): a patch. A chosen value's tag in a field of size 1 or 2 prints sf-tag--height-low, its former spacing-compact's new name (component.tags 1.3.0, journal class-tag-spacing-to-height); drawn the same. An avatar option's picture address is a quoted url(), so an address with a space draws (docs precheck smart content LI-01). Settings, values, events and keys unchanged.

version 1.13.0 (2026-11-14, owner decision C151 point 8; written on fix/icons-c151 above every origin fix branch, max 1.12.0 on fix/tags-c145): a minor. Search finds an icon option by its glyph's words as well as its label, in Russian and in English (SF.icons.choices.words, core/js/icon-choices.js iconWords; a glyph outside the choice is found by its name read as words): a product's icon chooser labels its options with the glyph name, and «папка» found nothing in the grid of 120 glyphs. Options, events and drawing unchanged.

$comment: css: its own sheet, the slot of an inherited value (simai/ui-source#28).

value.description: The value of the item chosen or cleared; "" when none.

values.description: Every selected value after the change.

item.description: The chosen option's data (text, value, type, icon, disabled, group, ...), not the sf-list-item element; null when a value was cleared.

root.description: The emitting sf-dropdown, the live element (the detail is not JSON).

multiple.description: Whether several values can be selected.

ai_guidance.use_when: Use sf-dropdown when a form needs one or several values from a concealed option set. Use direct sf-list-item children with stable machine values and visible labels. Use portal only when an ancestor clips the popup.
do_not: Do not copy generated ui-smart code
Do not move host data or access decisions into the component
Do not use the visible label as the submitted value when a stable machine identifier exists
Do not make decorative checkbox, avatar or icon content independently focusable inside an option
ai_guidance.minimal_example: <sf-dropdown label="Статус" name="status" placeholder="Выберите статус"><sf-list-item value="open" text="Открыт"></sf-list-item><sf-list-item value="done" text="Готов"></sf-list-item></sf-dropdown>

accessibility.focus: The toggle is the primary Tab stop. Arrow keys open and move through available options; Home and End move within the list, PageDown and PageUp by what it shows, and typed letters to the option they begin; the focused option is brought into view; Enter or Space selects; Escape closes and restores the toggle; Tab closes and continues native traversal. The searchbox keeps native text-editing Home and End behavior. After a reset back to the inherited value, focus returns to the control; while the value is inherited, the control carries it as aria-description and the visible marker is aria-hidden.

changes: portal is on by default: the list is positioned by SF.Position (Floating UI) in the native top layer, flips above near the bottom and stays inside the viewport.
portal="false" keeps the previous in-flow list.

sf-dropdown:change.summary: Legacy name for change, still emitted with the same detail; bind change.

sf-field:reset.summary: The person pressed the reset back to the inherited value. Fired before the field is emptied and cancellable: preventDefault keeps the value. When it is not prevented the field empties, says so with its ordinary change, shows the inherited value again and takes focus back.

value.description: The field's own value before the reset.

inheritedValue.description: The inherited value it returns to.

name.description: The form name, empty when the field has none.

resetToInherited.summary: Returns the field to its inherited value, as the reset button does: fires the cancellable sf-field-reset, then empties the own value and focuses the control. Returns whether it was reset (false without an inherited value, without an own value, while disabled or readonly, or when the event was prevented).

inherited-value.description: The option value (values joined by commas when several may be chosen) the field falls back to while nothing is chosen. Its options' labels are shown as inherited, in the placeholder's ink with an «inherited» marker, never as a choice: the form value stays empty. Once something is chosen, a reset button returns it here. Select mode; a tag-mode field does not draw it.

inherited-text.description: The words of the marker shown while the inherited value applies. Unset, it follows the page's language («inherited», «наследуется»).

reset-label.description: The accessible name of the button that returns the field to the inherited value. Unset, it follows the page's language («Reset to inherited», «Сбросить к наследуемому»).
